## Iron-Armed Android (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 Male android brawler 5  
 NE Medium humanoid (human)  
 **Init** +7; **Senses** Perception +9  

**Defense**

 **AC** 23, touch 14, flat-footed 19 (+5 armor, +2 Dex, +2 dodge, +4 shield)  
 **hp** 52 (5d10+20)  
 **Fort** +7, **Ref** +7, **Will** +4  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** unarmed strike +11 (1d8+5) or flurry of blows +9/+9 (1d8+5)  
 **Ranged** dagger +7 (1d6+5/19-20) or dragon pistol +7 (1d8/x4 or 15-foot cone, 2d6 fire [DC 15])  
 **Special Attacks** brawler’s flurry, brawler’s strike (magic), close weapon Mastery, knockout 1/day (DC 17), maneuver training (disarm +1), martial flexibility 5/day  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** An iron-armed android possesses the prerequisite feats for many combat maneuvers. He may use martial flexibility to utilize Improved Disarm, as he is unafraid to grab a sword by the blade.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 21, **Dex** 14, **Con** 16, **Int** 10, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 8  
 **Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +10 (+11 disarm); **CMD** 25 (26 vs. disarm)  
 **Feats** Combat Expertise, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Unarmed Strike, Iron Will, Shield Focus, Weapon Focus (unarmed strike), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
 **Skills** Acrobatics +11, Climb +9, Intimidate +7, Knowledge (local) +8, Perception +9  
 **Languages** Common  
 **SQ** brawler’s cunning, martial training  
 **Combat Gear** potion of cure moderate wounds, potion of bull’s strength, potion of bear’s endurance; **Other Gear** +1 armored longcoat, +1 heavy steel shield, dragon pistol with 2 metal cartridges and 2 dragon’s breath cartridges, 2 daggers.
